title: Operator-Algebraic Methods for Asymptotic-Preserving Quantum Simulation of Open Systems
summary: We develop a mathematically rigorous framework for simulating \emph{multiscale physical systems} using quantum computational resources, by translating the \emph{language of asymptotic-preserving (AP) schemes} into the formalism of quantum channels and Lindbladian dynamics.
